title: Exact trace result cache
validatorNotApplicable: a member branch holds `manifest.json` (`trace-cache-member/v1`: function, engine source key and trees, q0 string, dps, and a list of shards with sha256) and content-addressed JSONL shards of (n, signed word, suffix) -> exact decimal string, not graph nodes. `scripts/trace-cache.sh restore` checks every shard's sha256 against the manifest and the manifest's member against the key it asked for, and `computations/trace_cache.py` then re-evaluates a sample of the loaded entries with the installed binary and refuses the cache on any mismatch, so a bad member is a miss or a refusal, never a served value.
summary: Exact results of qou's native Markov-trace producer, one branch per producer function, engine source tree, q0 and precision, so a long probe run resumes after a container restart and a re-run recomputes nothing.

avatar.reads: a stack of stored rows: exact values already computed, kept so they are read rather than recomputed

rationale: Owner request 2026-11-21 on PR #8940: an incremental calculation with stored cache data for `qbeta_derived_w_overdetermined_test_probe.py`, whose 4He run did not finish in two hours. Modelled on `wheel-cache` (bean qou-dgkf) and `lake-cache`: the directory is declared in qou.json with `storage: { branchPrefix, keyedBy: "family", keyFrom }`, one orphan branch per member. `derived`: every value is recomputable from the engine source it is keyed on, and is never edited.
